name: release-planning
description: Build a velocity-based release roadmap with risk buffers. Use when the user says "release plan", "when will we ship", "plan the next release", "map sprints to milestones", "estimate our release date", "how many sprints until done", or wants to translate a backlog into a delivery timeline - even if they don't say "release planning". Based on "Agile Estimating and Planning" by Mike Cohn (velocity, story points, cone of uncertainty, risk buffers).
